tools.name: reactor_status
tools.description: Free: Money Reactor live base URL, health, prices, receiver wallet. Call this first.

tools.name: get_bounty_demo
tools.description: Free: top-3 funded bounties + honeypot sample + ROI pitch — rich preview of the paid feed.

tools.name: get_day_pass
tools.description: Day Pass: one $0.25 payment (x402, USDC Base) unlocks 24h of unlimited calls on every micro route. Buy once via tools/call settle, then send the returned dp_ token as X-DAY-PASS header. For agents making 20+ calls/day.

tools.name: get_bounty_feed
tools.description: Paid $0.10 (x402, USDC Base): multi-source bounty feed, hourly-refreshed — live Superteam Earn listings (USDC/USDG, $500-$10k), LIVE GitHub bounty radar (top open issues by reactions with trust scores, anonymous search) + GitLab bounty projects, trust >= 50. Send X-PAYMENT header to settle; without

tools.name: score_repo_trust
tools.description: Paid $0.10 (x402, USDC Base): trust score 0-100 + GO/CAUTION/HONEYPOT_RISK verdict + reasons for a GitHub repo. Screen bounties before working them — one avoided rug pays for 1000 calls.

tools.name: repo_verdict
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): one-line GO / CAUTION / HONEYPOT_RISK verdict for a repo. Impulse-priced pre-flight check.

tools.name: get_crypto_price
tools.description: Paid $0.01 (x402, USDC Base): live crypto spot price in USD for a pair like BTC-USD / ETH-USD / SOL-USD. Sourced from Coinbase public price APIs, edge-cached up to 30s.

tools.name: read_url_text
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): fetch any http(s) web page and return clean plain text (title + visible body, scripts/styles stripped, up to 8000 chars). Gives text-only agents web reading. Private/internal hosts blocked.

tools.name: get_crypto_news
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): top crypto headlines aggregated from Cointelegraph/Decrypt/NewsBTC RSS with per-article source links and publish times. Daily brief for trading and research agents.

tools.name: get_usd_price
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): multi-asset USD price snapshot in ONE call — up to 25 pairs (default 10 majors: BTC/ETH/SOL/DOGE/XRP/ADA/AVAX/LINK/LTC/USDC). Batch beats per-pair calls for portfolio and dashboard agents.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Paid $0.01 (x402, USDC Base): crypto Fear & Greed index — today + yesterday + week ago + 10-day history (0=extreme fear, 100=extreme greed). Market sentiment signal for trading agents.

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): full market snapshot in ONE call — batch USD prices (default BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/DOGE, optional symbols arg) + Fear & Greed sentiment + latest Base block. One poll replaces three calls; ideal for monitoring loops.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Paid $0.01 (x402, USDC Base): current weather for any city worldwide (temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, conditions) via Open-Meteo with city geocoding.

tools.name: get_erc20_balance
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): on-chain ERC20 token balance for any Base address via eth_call balanceOf on public Base RPC. Returns raw + human balance, decimals, symbol.

tools.name: get_token_verdict
tools.description: Paid $0.10 (x402, USDC Base): onchain safety verdict for a Base token — grade GREEN/MID/YELLOW/RED from liquidity, pair age, turnover, buy/sell flow and volatility (DexScreener data) with reasons. Screen tokens before interacting.

tools.name: get_latest_block
tools.description: Paid $0.01 (x402, USDC Base): latest Base mainnet block height (eth_blockNumber via public RPC). Cheapest chain-tip probe for agents.

tools.name: get_hash
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): cryptographic hash of any text via WebCrypto. Args: text (string), algo (sha256 default | sha1 | sha384 | sha512).

tools.name: encode_base64
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): Base64 encode/decode. Args: text (string), op ('enc' default | 'dec').

tools.name: gen_password
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): CSPRNG password/API-secret generator, 8-128 chars, classes upper/lower/digits/symbols, entropy estimate. Args: length (int, default 20).

tools.name: gen_random
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): CSPRNG random integers [min,max] or fair pick from list. Args: min, max, n, from (comma list).

tools.name: slugify_text
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): Unicode-safe URL slug generator. Args: text (string), sep (default '-'), max (default 80).

tools.name: convert_epoch
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): Epoch <-> ISO-8601 time converter with UTC parts and relative age. Args: ts (unix) or iso (string).

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): text analytics - chars, words, sentences, paragraphs, reading time, top keywords. Args: text (string).

tools.name: decode_jwt
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): JWT decoder - header + payload + expiry status, NO signature verification (inspection only). Args: token (string).

tools.name: cron_next
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): cron solver - next N execution times (UTC) for a standard 5-field cron expression. Args: expr (string), n (int, default 5).

tools.name: convert_color
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): color converter - HEX/RGB/HSL, WCAG luminance, contrast ratios, readable text suggestion. Args: color (string).

tools.name: gen_lorem
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): lorem ipsum generator, 1-20 randomized paragraphs. Args: p (int, default 3).

tools.name: gen_uuid
tools.description: Paid $0.01 (x402, USDC Base): random UUID v4 — idempotency keys and x402 requestKeys on demand; also a canonical low-cost target for testing x402 payment stacks.

tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Paid $0.01 (x402, USDC Base): current server time in UTC ISO-8601 with unix seconds. Cheapest liveness/time probe.

tools.name: get_base_gas
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): live Base gas — gas price, EIP-1559 base fee and suggested priority fee in Gwei. Tx cost planning for agents.

tools.name: get_wallet_profile
tools.description: Paid $0.10 (x402, USDC Base): on-chain wallet profile on Base — ETH balance, tx count (nonce), USDC balance, activity tier (fresh/new/active/veteran). Pre-flight counterparty check.

tools.name: get_coin_convert
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): convert an amount between assets at live USD spot (Coinbase) — e.g. 1 BTC = ? ETH. Rate + result in one call.

tools.name: get_btc_halving
tools.description: Paid $0.02 (x402, USDC Base): next Bitcoin halving — current height, blocks left, ETA, post-halving reward. Evergreen countdown.

tools.name: ai_chat
tools.description: Paid $0.10 (x402, USDC Base): LLM chat completion (Llama 3.1 8B, Cloudflare Workers AI). Args: prompt (string) OR messages (array of {role, content}), optional system, max_tokens. One-shot AI inference per call, no signup.

tools.name: research_report
tools.description: Paid $0.50 full / $0.10 preview (x402, USDC Base): LLM 70B writes a structured 7-section research report on your question — executive summary, market context, key data grounded in LIVE prices + Fear & Greed + headlines, bull case, bear case, watchlist, bottom line. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp2" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_bounty_demo, get_bounty_feed, read_url_text, get_crypto_news, get_btc_halving · Private data: reactor_status, get_day_pass, read_url_text, get_erc20_balance, get_token_verdict, gen_password, decode_jwt, get_wallet_profile, research_report · Public sink: get_day_pass, get_bounty_feed, get_crypto_news, get_btc_halving.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_bounty_demo, get_bounty_feed, read_url_text, get_crypto_news, get_btc_halving · Private data: reactor_status, get_day_pass, read_url_text, get_erc20_balance, get_token_verdict, gen_password, decode_jwt, get_wallet_profile, research_report · Public sink: get_day_pass, get_bounty_feed, get_crypto_news, get_btc_halving

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
